product.name: Product-Helper
product.tagline: One command installs living PRD, kanban, and guardrail skills for Cursor, Claude, Codex, and ChatGPT.
users: Software teams and coding agents working in a repository
Human product managers who own priorities and accept work
product.problem: Teams and coding agents lose the plan: the PRD goes stale, the board lives elsewhere, and each agent forgets the rules. Product-Helper keeps one living PRD, one kanban the human PM owns, and guardrails every agent must re-read.
product.vision:
## Vision

Product-Helper makes the plan obvious: a living PRD, a kanban board the human PM owns, and guardrails every coding agent must honor. Distribution is the product — npm CLI, Cursor plugin, and copy-into-repo skills for Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT/Codex.

cards.title: Living PRD

cards.title: Kanban PM board
cards.description: Offline HTML board with card drawer, now/next/later, and a highlighted product-doc viewer.

cards.title: Guardrails
cards.description: Built-in safety rules plus a Custom section agents re-read before acting.

cards.title: Multi-agent skills
cards.description: Same workflow as Cursor, Claude Code, and ChatGPT/Codex skills, published on npm as product-helper@1.0.2.

cards.title: CLI
cards.description: init installs the workspace. serve opens the board. sync and status are optional fallbacks, not the daily loop.

cards.title: Agent-first usage story
cards.description: README leads with `npx product-helper init`. That one command copies skills; agents then update the PRD and board. Humans do not run sync after every change.

decisions.title: Agent owns the daily loop
decisions.body: Accepted 2026-09-12. After `init`, Cursor / Claude / Codex / ChatGPT update the PRD and board themselves. CLI `sync` and `status` stay as optional fallbacks. Humans do not run them after every change.
